verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring workflows is a fair question for a meeting-intelligence SaaS, but the evidence shows only event-driven automation, not recurring time-based scheduling. Examples are webhooks fired on new meeting content, CRM sync after meetings, keyword alerts, and async per-request delivery via destination_url. These are one-off or event-triggered actions, so they do not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
